measured.machine: 8 GB Apple M1 laptop, MPS fp16, one request at a time; drafter + embedder + reranker in process

assumptions.machine_note: 0.35 USD/h stands in for an on-prem Apple-silicon box or a small GPU VM (A10-class spot ~0.3-0.6 USD/h); the measured latency is from an 8 GB M1 laptop, which is slower than either

api_rate_card.note: GPT-4o-mini class stand-in; used since Week 7

breakdown_local.tools_note: order/entitlement/escalation are local calls (<5 ms); the MCP server is in the fixed share

basis_short: local compute at 0.35 USD/h x measured latency + infra share; clean deflections only

capacity.model: one in-process model behind the server's single lock (serial)

retrieval.pgvector: 13 docs / 189 chunks: exact scan < 10 ms; at 10x corpus still < 50 ms with HNSW
retrieval.reranker: cross-encoder ~100-300 ms per query on CPU

capacity.mcp_server: one uvicorn process; the embedder and reranker load once; one search ~0.2-1 s warm; stateless HTTP scales horizontally
capacity.rate_limits: none for local models; on the API basis 20k tickets/week x ~1.3k tokens = ~26M tokens/week, inside typical tier limits but needs retries/backoff
capacity.first_failure_point: the serial model lock: at the Black Friday peak the queue grows faster than one worker drains it

tenx_plan: Run the drafter as a worker pool (N = peak RPS x mean latency x 1.5) behind a queue; the server already returns 409 instead of queueing, so add a job queue (Redis/RQ or Celery) and poll for the result
Move generation off the 1.5B local model to a hosted endpoint or a GPU box; measured mean latency is the lever, not token cost
Keep the MCP help-centre server stateless and run 2+ replicas; cache search results per (query, policy_version) for 5 minutes
Postgres: HNSW index on chunks.embedding, pooled connections, read replica for retrieval
Observability: rotate traces.jsonl daily; the SQLite index becomes Postgres once >1 writer exists
Pre-check the cheap deterministic paths (sensitive intents escalate in <50 ms with no model) so they never wait behind generation
